description_en: Attaches an Android Debug Bridge (ADB) key pair to one or more cloud phone instances
description_zh: 调用AttachKeyPair绑定一个ADB密钥对到一台或多台云手机实例
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic attach-key-pair --key-pair-id kp-6v2q33ae4tw3a0000 --instance-ids acp-5hh4a31emkt6u0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachKeyPair

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ADB key pair
parameters.name: key_pair_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the cloud phone instances. You can specify a maximum of 50 cloud phone instances
parameters.help_zh: 云手机实例ID列表，最多支持50个实例
parameters.name: instance_ids
